import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])

    cells = N * M
    base = R - L + 1
    exponent = cells

    value = pow(base, exponent, MOD)

    if cells % 2 == 1:
        print(value)
        return

    if (R - L) % 2 == 0:
        value += 1

    value = (value * ((MOD + 1) // 2)) % MOD
    print(value)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
